channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-streaming
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: bus — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Event bus framework for Apache Kafka with protobuf-typed producers and consumer groups, retries, batch handlers, and automatic offset commits.

item.title: rekuiper — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Single-binary streaming SQL engine for filtering, aggregating, and routing MQTT and industrial telemetry on edge gateways.

item.title: mq-bridge — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Embeddable library and CLI for moving data between brokers, databases incl. CDC, object storage and HTTP, usable from Rust, Python and Node.js.

item.title: cdclint — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Linter for the contract between Postgres migrations, a Debezium connector and the sink schema, failing the pull request that would silently drop a CDC column.

item.title: OLake — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Replicates Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server and Kafka into Apache Iceberg with CDC, full refresh and incremental sync.

item.title: Clink — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Embedded-first, Arrow-native stream processing engine with streaming SQL and exactly-once checkpoints.

item.title: PySAD — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Python library for anomaly detection on streaming data, with online detectors, stream simulators, and evaluators.

item.title: StreamPulse — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Real-time Kafka telemetry ingestion and stream processing pipeline with Redis sliding-window aggregations and live dashboard.

item.title: SQLFlow — via awesome-streaming
item.description: Stream processing engine that runs DuckDB SQL over Kafka, WebSocket, and webhook streams.
